remarks: This custom-designed and meticulously maintained LAKE Home offers 6 spacious BEDRMS and 5.5 BATHS with an open floorplan that captures PANORAMIC lakefront views throughout - apx 150 of lakefront with a gorgeous dock - all on apx 4.2 acres.  The front entry opens to a MAIN level foyer (2nd floor) with HW floors, Finelli ironwork stairway, walk-in closet, an ELEVATOR, and powder room.  The Great Room with electronic shades, includes a high-end kitchen with walk-in pantry, Gas/WB Fireplace, and seamless flow to Lakeside living and dining areas, all opening to an expansive wraparound lakefront deck with covered and uncovered areas. An outdoor kitchen with skylight adjoins a covered 3-season porch with NanaWall system allowing open, windowed, or screened configurations. An adjacent office is off the kitchen. A library features custom cherry millwork (sourced in part from the property) and floor-to-ceiling bookcases, plus a gas FP and walk-in closet. The Primary Suite enjoys scenic Lake views, a bath with Toto fixtures, Whirlpool Tub, marble double vanities, glass-enclosed shower, and skylight.  2 large walk-in closets and a windowed dressing area. A spacious laundry/mudroom offers access to a front courtyard entrance, and a 3+ car garage plus a future, potential greenhouse off the rear patio (with plumbing connections). The above-grade lower level (1st floor) includes 5 BDRMS, 4 ENSUITE, all with lake views, and includes a kitchenette, walk-out access to an expansive lakefront patio, a large recreation area with additional patio access, and a substantial exercise room (with beams and concrete walls). Features include wide hallways, custom-milled solid doors, a 2nd laundry closet, and amazing storage.  Systems: central HVAC, zoned radiant floor heating (lst flr), Commercial-sized GENERATOR, and ceiling fans. Extensively landscaped grounds with limestone retaining walls and caps, and a hillside patio with panoramic views. Lakeside utilities are buried. Detached maintenance/storage building (26’×34’) with utilities.  The property called Wooded Lane is approached via a scenic driveway. Offered Mostly Furnished.
